dedupe_keys.name: 防災マッフテータ 防災アセス 活断層分布図 fire police and emergency services and earthquakes

description: 防災マップデータ 防災アセス 活断層分布図 [fire, police and emergency services and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大津市. 防災アセス（活断層分布）は、平成16年度に実施した防災アセスメントで調査した活断層の分布を地図上に示したものです。 【活断層の説明】 活断層（確実度Ⅰ）：最近数十万年に、概ね千年から数万年の周期で繰り返し動いてきた跡が地形に現れ、今後も活動を繰り返すと考えられる断層。 明瞭な地形的証拠から位置が特定できるもの。 活断層（確実度Ⅱ）：活断層... Coverage: 大津市. The portal files it under the publisher 大津市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 地震, 活断層, 災害, 防災. It offers 3 resource(s) in kml, shape, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
